note: Illinois DNR park along the Kankakee River north-west of Bourbonnais. Potawatomi Campground is wooded and set back from the river; its gates close to vehicles from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m., and the park takes no credit cards on site. The separate Chippewa Campground, about 6 km west, has electric-only and non-electric sites without showers. --Claude
